questions.question: How does Felice Frankel describe a photograph?
options: A representation of reality, not the thing itself.

questions.question: Are colour-enhanced Hubble images dishonest?
options: No: the enhancement can add information.

questions.question: What was wrong with the first AI image of the nanocrystals?
options: It mixed colours and added dots that weren't real.
It was in black and white.

questions.question: What happened when she used the same prompt six months later?
options: The image was much closer to her real photo.

questions.question: Should an AI-generated image be considered scientific documentation?
options: No, because it doesn't record a real thing.

questions.question: Which of these does she NOT ask researchers to report?
options: How much the AI tool cost.
The AI model and version they used.
